name: Hiconics Battery
tagline: Single-phase all-in-one home storage with stackable battery modules.
summary: The Hiconics HiEnergy-S (HEC2 Series) is a single-phase all-in-one residential energy storage system that uses high-voltage battery modules.
The models in the spec sheet hold 10.2 kWh to 30.6 kWh in total. The system is rated IP65 and has a 94% battery round-trip efficiency.

highlights.title: Thermal management
highlights.text: Advanced thermal management supports reliable performance.

highlights.title: Modular and stackable
highlights.text: Battery modules stack, so capacity can be matched to the home.

highlights.title: Built for extremes
highlights.text: Engineered for extreme environmental conditions, with IP65 protection.

highlights.title: Smooth changeover
highlights.text: Moves smoothly between on-grid and off-grid power.
